training_duration_selection: highest inner-validation argmax spellF1 among best-loss checkpoints within each cap; ties prefer smaller cap
B_sampling: 50 percent IDSSE windows, 50 percent SkillCorner; same optimizer updates as A
duration_statistics: only outer-training IDSSE, excludes edge-censored state runs; H/A durations pooled
model_selection_score: 0.5 clean validation spellF1 + 0.25 validation 40pct/5s blocks + 0.25 validation 40pct/15s blocks

decoder_grid.hsmm_tail: unbounded geometric tail; no forced maximum possession length

outer_test_policy: each choice frozen from own inner validation before loading test arrays; no global winner chosen from outer scores
extra_seeds: repeat per-fold validation-selected condition and cap; freeze decoder hyperparameters chosen with seed 2027
uncertainty: fold mean and sample SD; paired match bootstrap differences; additional seed variation of selected pipeline
